descriptions.scan: The FROM source of this query block. Bind a local table, CTE or derived query with scan or joins before referencing its columns; declaring a CTE alone is not a FROM binding. Correlated references may use a visible enclosing scope.
descriptions.cte: Named query blocks. Each query.select defines its exported columns; downstream blocks may reference only those exported names. A CTE definition does not add the CTE to scan or joins.
descriptions.agg: Aggregate definitions local to this query block. Refer to a definition by its exact as alias. Defining an aggregate does not add it to select or export it to another query block.
descriptions.window: Window definitions local to this query block. Refer to a definition by its exact as alias. Use qualify for filtering them in this block. Downstream blocks can reference a window result only if select exports it.
descriptions.select: The output interface of this query block. In a CTE, explicitly select the columns or expressions needed downstream. In the final query, return only the requested answer columns or expressions, not intermediate counts or helper values unless requested.
